changelog:
- Initial release of the korta-obsidian skill.
- Provides commands and guidance for working with Obsidian vaults using obsidian-cli.
- Includes instructions for vault discovery, search, note creation, move/rename (with link updates), and delete operations.
- Offers tips for safely automating Obsidian workflows and suggests best practices for vault path handling.
summary: Work with Obsidian vaults (plain Markdown notes) and automate via obsidian-cli.
